messages:
sasha: Quick question — we want a promo effective same week as a candidates' location change + benefits enrollment. Can we pick an effective date that avoids benefit gaps and messy retro? :thinking:
liam: Short answer: aim for the first day of a new pay period in the new location if possible. Benefits often enroll on month-starts; payroll cutoffs vary. What dates are we targeting?
sasha: Candidate relocation effective Sept 9, manager prefers promo Sept 15 to line up with new title.
neha: Sept 15 might create a benefits gap if the US plan only starts 9/1. If you move mid-month you could either: (a) make promo 9/1, (b) keep promo 9/15 and process a one-time enrollment exception, or (c) do promo on 10/1 to align both payroll+benefits — each has tradeoffs.
tori: For comp/grant alignment, loop @comp-ops early. They need to sign off if you want grant timing moved. Also confirm if retro will be processed in origin country or destination country payroll.
sasha: Manager also asked about returning submissions that lack examples. Do we have a short pasteable return message?
people-ops-bot: Leveling checklist: https://intra.redwood/people-ops/leveling-checklist. Required: impact summary, 2+ concrete examples with metrics, manager endorsement, recent peer feedback (<6mo) when available. Use template: /templates/leveling-evidence.md
neha: Suggested return text (paste): "Thanks — please add 2 quantified examples showing scope increase, attach any internal feedback <6mo or manager attestation, and confirm proposed effective date with payroll/benefits. Resubmit within 14 days."
liam: If peer feedback is old (7-11 months), allow with manager rationale documented in the submission. If older than 11 months, require at least one recent corroborating metric or project note.
sasha: Who signs off on exceptions? Manager says VP verbally approved.
tori: Approval chain for exceptions: Manager + Sr People Ops partner + Compensation. Verbal VP ok as context, but we need written approval logged in the Promo Portal or an email attached to the submission. Tag @people-ops for routing.
neha: I'll check benefits cutoffs for the candidate's countries and post the exact enroll dates here. If timeline is tight, consider small retro pay rather than delaying offer.
sasha: Thanks — I'll ask manager to use the return text if needed and cc payroll/comp. :thumbsup:
